content: In many Vietnamese processing tasks such as Part-of-Speech Tagging, Syntax Parsing or Chunking, there requires a step to concatenate those subwords to make a word since in those tasks, word is necessarily considered as the smallest unit to be processed. This step is normally referred to as word segmentation. There are various word segmentation methods; The best ones are using machine learning approaches to learn from a labeled corpus. It makes the tasks hard and expensive to be applied in other domains. Furthermore, the translation unit in Machine Translation does not need to be a word but can be a subword or sequence of subwords if it have its own meaning.
